augmentation.native_fraction_scope: Legacy sampled-augmentation helper only; exhaustive builder emits all eight transforms
augmentation.scope: One transformation shared by all demonstration inputs, demonstration outputs, query inputs and query outputs

evaluation: All original public tasks are training-eligible. Synthetic validation uses disjoint input equivalence classes. Leaderboard submissions are tracked separately; do not assume private per-task feedback is available.

label_policy.public_training_pairs: Use the hash-pinned teaching_fixture for explicitly reviewed corrections; otherwise use canonical labels. Never include conflicting original/corrected versions in the training mixture.
label_policy.official_evaluation: Always retain original benchmark labels for original-benchmark scoring.
label_policy.synthetic_eligibility: Correction approval does not register a generator; randomized and independent semantic validation are still required.
